DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('lineitem'[l_receiptdate])),
			'lineitem'[l_receiptdate] < DATE(1994, 2, 26)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP('orders'[o_orderpriority], 'orders'[o_orderstatus]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Avg_Disc", 'lineitem'[Avg Disc],
			"Avg_Price", 'lineitem'[Avg Price],
			"Customer_Count", 'lineitem'[Customer Count],
			"Charge", 'lineitem'[Charge],
			"Order_Count", 'lineitem'[Order Count],
			"Qty", 'lineitem'[Qty],
			"Revenue", 'lineitem'[Revenue]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[Avg_Disc],
			0,
			'orders'[o_orderpriority],
			1,
			'orders'[o_orderstatus],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[Avg_Disc] DESC,
	'orders'[o_orderpriority],
	'orders'[o_orderstatus]
